name: law-student
description: Socratic drilling, IRAC practice, case briefing, bar exam prep, and exam performance forecasting for law students.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial profile setup — learns your law school, year, bar jurisdiction, course load, and study preferences in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: socratic-drill
skills.description: Run a Socratic dialogue on a rule, doctrine, or case — questions escalate in difficulty until the student demonstrates command

skills.name: irac-practice
skills.description: Grade and coach an IRAC-structured answer — identifies rule gaps, analysis weaknesses, and conclusory reasoning

skills.name: bar-prep
skills.description: Generate MBE-style practice questions, MEE essay prompts, or MPT tasks keyed to your bar jurisdiction and target subjects

skills.name: case-brief
skills.description: Produce a structured case brief (facts, issue, holding, reasoning, concurrences/dissents, significance) for any cited decision

skills.name: exam-forecast
skills.description: Analyze a course syllabus and prior exams to forecast high-probability issue-spotting areas for an upcoming exam
